dash.title: Dashboard
dash.sub: Live state of the Qahr Mobile server: services, players, Hot Reload, latest errors and client versions.
dash.onlineSub: of {0} characters in the database · max level {1}
dash.hrOn: Any saved .cs change is applied to the running server in about a second, players stay logged in.

dash.noDevices: No device asked for an update in the last 14 days.

srv.title: Servers
srv.sub: Safe start and stop for GameServer and AccServer. Every stop saves the players first, and every step is shown before it happens.
srv.gameRole: Game server · runs under dotnet watch (Hot Reload)
srv.accRole: Login + update check and download + register
srv.safeRestartTip: Check build → save players → stop → Hot Reload build → start (like run_live.ps1)
srv.saveTip: Saves every online player now (AdminApi save all)
srv.rebuildTip: Check build → stop → build bin\Debug → start
srv.gNoteOff: The server is stopped. "Start" runs it under dotnet watch so changes apply while it runs.
srv.gNoteWatch: Hot Reload is on: save any .cs file and it applies in about a second. Big edits (e.g. a changed method signature) need a restart.
srv.gNoteNoWatch: The server runs without dotnet watch. Changes will not apply by themselves; "Safe restart" brings Hot Reload back.
srv.gNoteRestart: Hot Reload: {0}. The last change applies only after a "Safe restart".
srv.accNote: AccServer keeps no data in memory. Stopping it closes login, updates and register until it is back; players in game are not affected. Its console goes to acc.log.
srv.startMsg: The server starts under Hot Reload, like run_live.ps1.
srv.stopMsg: The server stops and players are disconnected. In this order:
srv.stopNotePlayers: {0} players are online now; they are saved first, then disconnected.
srv.restartMsg: Same as run_live.ps1, with a code check first: if the build has errors the server is not touched at all.
srv.noApiMsg: The AdminApi does not answer, so the players cannot be saved before the stop. Anything not in the last periodic save may be lost. Stop anyway?
srv.accStartMsg: AccServer starts and its console is written to acc.log.
srv.accStopMsg: New logins, updates and register stop until it is back. Players in game are not affected.
srv.rebuildMsg: The code is checked first; if it has errors nothing is stopped.
srv.failed: Did not complete, see the console
srv.step.save: Save every online player ({0}) through the AdminApi
srv.step.saveNoApi: The AdminApi does not answer: the players cannot be saved before the stop
srv.step.killWatch: Stop dotnet watch (PID {0}) so it does not restart the server
srv.step.killGame: Stop Qahr.Mobile.Game.exe (PID {0}) — only the one under QahrMobile
srv.step.check: Check build in a temp folder (the running server is not touched)
srv.step.liveBuild: dotnet build -c Debug --property:Optimize=false (needed for Hot Reload)
srv.step.watch: Start dotnet watch run, console to watch.log and watch.err.log
srv.step.archive: Keep a copy of the old watch.log and watch.err.log
srv.step.archiveAcc: Keep a copy of the old acc.log
srv.step.waitListen: Wait until the port is open
srv.step.accDown: Login, updates and register are closed until the next start
ops.stillListening: The port is still open after the stop; check who holds it.
ops.listening: {0} is listening on port {1} after {2} s.
ops.notListening: The server did not open in time, see the console.
ops.checkBuild: Checking the build in a temp folder…
ops.checkFailed: The code has errors; nothing was stopped. See the Build page.
ops.liveBuildFailed: The build failed; dotnet watch builds again and writes the errors to watch.err.log.
ops.liveBuildFailedOld: The build failed; starting the previous version.
build.title: Build & APK
build.sub: Check the code without touching the server, the real build, and build the players' APK and install it on a phone or emulator.
build.checkTip: Compiles into a temp folder (%TEMP%); the running server is not touched
build.liveTip: Builds into bin (the server must be stopped)
build.hintGameRunning: GameServer is running: the check is safe; the real build happens in "Safe restart".
build.hintAccRunning: AccServer is running: the check is safe; the real build is in "Build & restart".
build.hintStopped: The server is stopped: check or real build.
build.ready: Pick the project and press "Check build".
build.failed: {0} errors and {1} warnings — double-click a row to open the file
build.issueTip: Double-click opens the file at the line
build.liveRunningGame: The real build needs GameServer stopped (its exe is locked). Use "Safe restart" on the Servers page: it saves the players, builds and starts it again.
build.liveRunningAcc: The real build needs AccServer stopped. Use "Build & restart" on the Servers page.
build.liveMsg: {0} is built into its run folder.
build.liveStep2: Nothing is started; start it from the Servers page
apk.ip: Server IP the players connect to
apk.ipHint: The VPS public IP, or a LAN IP for tests.
apk.patchHostHint: empty = same IP; 127.0.0.1 = no update check at all.
apk.singleHint: One file to tap-install or adb install. Without it you get 4 split files.
apk.ready: Fill in the form and press "Build the APK".
apk.building: Building the APK… (a minute or two)
apk.confirmMsg: A signed APK pointed at our server is built:
apk.overwrite: An older APK in the same folder will be overwritten.
apk.noDevices: No device connected (start the emulator or plug in a phone with USB debugging).
apk.noFile: No APK in the output folder yet.
apk.step.keepData: The data on the device is kept (update, not wipe)
apk.installNote: If the game is open on the device it will be closed.
upd.title: Mobile updates
upd.sub: Players' latest version {0} · {1} published updates · mode {2} · {3}
upd.openConsoleTip: Opens the full update tool (edit every path, mode and port settings)
upd.dropHint: A folder laid out like ConquerRes (ini, luaui …) or single files
upd.comparing: Comparing with what the players have…
upd.versionHint: Last used number {0}. Numbers only go up.
upd.notesHint: Kept in the history only, not sent to players.
upd.modeOk: Mode Update: phones will download it.
upd.modeReady: Mode Ready: phones will not download updates until you change it in PatchConsole.
upd.httpDown: The download server is not running (AccServer stopped?).
upd.big: Larger than 50 MB: players on mobile data are asked before the download.

upd.versionUsed: The number must be above the last used one ({0}).
upd.confirmMsg: Every phone gets the update the next time the game opens:
upd.step.verify: Open the zip again and check it (paths, version.dat, forbidden files)
upd.step.copy: Copy as .part, check the checksum, then rename to {0}
upd.step.live: The AccServer reads the folder on every request: no restart needed
upd.testTip: Asks like a 5150 phone, downloads every update, tests resume and checksum (read only)
upd.col.title: Title
upd.pickOne: Pick an update in the table first.
upd.rollbackMsg: The server stops sending it right away. The file is not deleted; it moves to _removed.
upd.removeMsgMiddle: This is not the latest update: phones that have not downloaded it will skip it.
upd.rollbackNote: {0} devices already downloaded it and keep its files. To bring the old files back, publish a new update with the old copies.
upd.step.phones: The number is never reused (devices may have it)
upd.testOk: Test passed: every update downloads correctly.
upd.testFail: The test found problems, see the lines.
upd.off.none: No data from the official mirror yet
mir.title: Official mirror
mir.sub: Follow TQ's official updates, download them, analyse them and republish them from our server under their number — all through official_mirror.py.
mir.checkTip: Asks TQ's servers (port 9547) what comes after our version, no download
mir.fetchTip: Downloads any new official patch (publishes nothing)
mir.cdnVerifyTip: Check the CDN files against the official CRC list
mir.col.name: Patch
mir.newFound: A new official update: {0} — press "Download new"
mir.upToDate: Nothing new: we are on the latest official version.
mir.fetchMsg: Any new official patch is downloaded. Players get nothing until you "Republish".
mir.step.ask: Ask TQ's servers for the update chain after our latest version
mir.step.download: Download every new zip into {0} (resumes if cut)
mir.step.noPublish: Nothing is published to players in this step
mir.pick: Pick a patch in the table first.
mir.repubMsg: The official update is published from our server and every phone downloads it:
pl.title: Players & live ops
pl.sub: Who is online, kick, messages, reload data without a restart, and GM commands — all through the AdminApi.
pl.col.name: Name
pl.popup: Popup in the middle of the screen
pl.kickPh: Shown to the player before the disconnect
pl.kickMsg: The player is disconnected from the server:
pl.step.disconnect: Disconnect (the character is saved like a normal logout)
pl.step.relog: They can log in again right away (this is not a ban)
pl.reloadHint: After editing Data files, the server reads them again while players are in.
pl.reloadMsg: The server reads the files again and applies the difference right away:
pl.step.reloadSafe: If the file has a bad line the whole reload is cancelled and nothing changes
pl.gmHint: The server runs the command as an online GM character, as if typed in chat.
pl.noGm: No GM online: log in with a GM character first.

bk.title: Backup
bk.sub: Database and the Data folder in one zip in {0} (the last {1} are kept).
bk.emptyHint: Make the first one with the card on the side
bk.pick: Pick a backup in the table.
bk.restoreHint: Every live restore makes a "pre-restore" backup first so you can go back.

bk.refuseData: Restoring the live Data needs GameServer stopped. Stop it first or restore into another folder.
bk.badDbName: Database name: letters, digits and _ only.
bk.copyIsLive: That is the live database name; choose "The live database" if you mean it.
bk.restoreDbCopyTitle: Restore the database as a copy
bk.step.preDb: A "pre-restore" backup of the current database
bk.step.replace: The tables in the backup are fully replaced
bk.step.copyOnly: The live data is not touched
bk.step.preData: A "pre-restore" backup of the current Data
bk.step.keepOthers: Files not in the backup stay as they are
